ai.hops: Found in {count} step. | Found in {count} steps.
ai.providerHint: Choosing a provider enables the ✦ button in the search bar.
ai.baseUrlHint: Clicking a known address fills the field and suggests its model. Any other address — a proxy, a gateway — can be typed in; when empty, the provider’s default address is used.
ai.apiKeyHint: Stored in config.yml on the server; it is never sent back to the interface.
ai.modelHint: Pick the model from the list the provider returns: fill in the key, click Test, then Save. The list is kept, so you can switch models later without re-entering the key.

admin.title: Administration
admin.subtitle: settings and notes
admin.hint: Applied and written to {file} on click.
admin.watchHint: Useful when the filesystem does not report files dropped outside the interface (shared folder, network mount): empty = automatic, 0 = disabled.
admin.watchLocal: “{fs}” filesystem: local, changes are detected in real time.
admin.watchVirtual: “{fs}” filesystem, virtualised: it does not report files dropped from your machine, hence a re-scan recommended every {seconds} s.
admin.watchUnknown: Local filesystem: changes are detected in real time.
admin.ssoEnable: Allow signing in through the identity provider
admin.ssoEnableHint: A second way in: local accounts and passwords keep working. Accounts created by the SSO get the default role.
admin.ssoLocked: Some fields are set by the environment (EASY3D_OIDC_*) and are greyed out here.
admin.ssoIssuerHint: The one the provider announces as its "issuer". Configuration is discovered from there.
admin.ssoClientSecretHint: Never sent back in the clear: the field holds *** when a secret is stored, and clearing it removes it.
admin.ssoScopesHint: Space separated. Empty = openid email profile — the e-mail address is required to match a manually prepared account.
admin.ssoRedirect: Redirect URL to declare at the provider

ssoMissing.issuer: Incomplete configuration: the issuer URL is missing.
ssoMissing.client_id: Incomplete configuration: the client ID is missing.
ssoMissing.client_secret: Incomplete configuration: the client secret is missing.

auto.label: Create the account automatically
auto.hint: Anyone authenticated at the provider gets an account, with the default role. Simple, but the provider directory has the final say.

manual.label: Prepared accounts only
manual.hint: An administrator creates the account here (same e-mail address): the first sign-in links it and stores the provider identity. Nobody gets in without an account.

approval.label: Create, then approve
approval.hint: The account is created disabled on first sign-in: the Accounts page is the approval screen. The person is told the account is waiting.

delete.title: Delete
delete.whatFolder: “{name}” and its {count} file will be permanently deleted. | “{name}” and its {count} files will be permanently deleted.

account.mismatch: The two entries do not match.
account.changed: Password changed. The other sessions have been closed.
account.passwordHint: 8 characters minimum. Changing it closes the other sessions: devices left open will have to sign in again.
account.tokensHint: For agents (Claude Code, a script, a CI): they identify themselves with a token rather than a cookie, and never have more rights than you.
account.tokenOnce: Copy this token now: it will not be shown again.
account.mcpHint: For an MCP agent: the server address, and this token as an Authorization: Bearer header.

errors.forbidden: Your account is not allowed to do that.

accounts.rolesHint: The built-in roles are frozen: clone one to start from something.
accounts.passwordHint: Optional: without a password, the account can only sign in through the identity provider (SSO).
accounts.cloneHint: Create an empty role, or clone one: its permissions are copied over. That is the usual way to build a role to measure.
accounts.frozen: Built-in role: frozen. Clone it to change its permissions.
accounts.hint: A permission ticked here adds to the ones from the roles. The last administrator cannot be disabled or deleted.
accounts.defaultHint: With no role ticked, the installation's default role applies.

errors.forbidden: Your account is not allowed to do that.
errors.last_admin: The last administrator cannot be removed.
errors.cannot_delete_self: You cannot delete your own account.
errors.role_frozen: A built-in role cannot be changed: clone it.
errors.email_taken: This e-mail address is already used.
